expression: sum by (cluster) (min without(resource) (kube_resourcequota{job="kube-state-metrics", type="hard", resource=~"(cpu|requests.cpu)"})) / sum by (cluster) (kube_node_status_allocatable{job="kube-state-metrics", resource="cpu"}) > 1.5

expression: sum by (cluster) (min without(resource) (kube_resourcequota{job="kube-state-metrics", type="hard", resource=~"(memory|requests.memory)"})) / sum by (cluster) (kube_node_status_allocatable{job="kube-state-metrics", resource="memory"}) > 1.5

annotations.description: Cluster {{ $labels.cluster}} has overcommitted memory resource requests for Namespaces. For more information on this alert, please refer to this [link](https://aka.ms/aks-alerts/cluster-level-recommended-alerts).
